crossRefs.note: Then he made an altar of bronze, twenty cubits long, twenty cubits wide, and ten cubits high.
This is the copy of the letter that they sent: To King Artaxerxes, From your servants the men beyond the River.
Then I proclaimed a fast there, at the river Ahava, that we might humble ourselves before our God, to seek from him a…
For I was ashamed to ask of the king a band of soldiers and horsemen to help us against the enemy on the way, because…
Yahweh is my light and my salvation. Whom shall I fear? Yahweh is the strength of my life. Of whom shall I be afraid?
When evildoers came at me to eat up my flesh, even my adversaries and my foes, they stumbled and fell.
My enemies want to swallow me up all day long, for they are many who fight proudly against me.
“Now this is that which you shall offer on the altar: two lambs a year old day by day continually.
“Command the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘See that you present my offering, my food for my offerings made by…

translations.web: In spite of their fear because of the peoples of the surrounding lands, they set the altar on its base; and they offered burnt offerings on it to Yahweh, even burnt offerings morning and evening.
translations.bsb: They set up the altar on its foundation and sacrificed burnt offerings on it to the LORD—both the morning and evening burnt offerings—even though they feared the people of the land.
translations.kjv: And they set the altar upon his bases; for fear was upon them because of the people of those countries: and they offered burnt offerings thereon unto the LORD, even burnt offerings morning and evening.
translations.asv: And they set the altar upon its base; for fear was upon them because of the peoples of the countries: and they offered burnt-offerings thereon unto Jehovah, even burnt-offerings morning and evening.
